narrative.intro: Barnard Construction obligated $5.9B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Barnard Construction won 11 awards so far, with an average award size of $535M. Barnard Construction obligations are up 2967.7% year over year. Barnard Construction received the bulk of FY2026 obligations from the Department of Homeland Security, which obligated $4.5B. The Department of Defense obligated $1.3B and the Department of Agriculture obligated $500K. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the largest market for Barnard Construction at $4.5B. Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction is the second market at $1.3B, and Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction is $500K. Historical obligations for Barnard Construction by fiscal year include $5.2M in FY21, $132M in FY22, $4.1M in FY23, $33.4M in FY24, and $192M in FY25. The note: all figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, and current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date).

sections.heading: Who are Barnard Construction's largest federal buyers?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security is Barnard Construction's largest buyer, obligating $4.5B. The Department of Defense is the next largest buyer, obligating $1.3B. The Department of Agriculture is also a buyer, obligating $500K.

sections.heading: What markets and contract sizes dominate Barnard Construction's federal work?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the largest market for Barnard Construction at $4.5B. Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction accounts for $1.3B and Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction accounts for $500K. Barnard Construction's awards total 11 and the average award size is $535M.
